card.title: Average speed
card.says: how far you went, divided by how long it took **in total**.
card.from: the definition of speed, applied to a whole interval instead of one instant.
card.useWhen: the question is about a whole trip and you know, or can find, the total distance and the total time.
card.analogy: Your average pocket money per day over a week: total money ÷ 7, even on days you got nothing.
